Trusts
I am beneficiary of the Sean J. Casey Family Trust which has interests in private corporations. 
The trust was not established for political reasons and I am ordered by the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, as required by paragraph 41.3(1)(b) of the Parliament of Canada Act, not to derive any income from it, including the disbursement of assets, for the purpose of financing a nomination contest, a leadership contest or an electoral campaign.
